product_desc: A Mini-ITX motherboard for 10th and 11th generation Intel Core processors with an LGA1200 socket, supporting up to 64GB of DDR4 memory, and featuring built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

product_features.Supported Processors: 10th Gen Intel Core Processors and 11th Gen Intel Core Processors
product_features.Storage Interfaces: 4 x SATA3, 1 x Ultra M.2 (PCIe Gen3 x4 & SATA3)
product_features.USB Ports: 4 x USB 3.2 Gen1 (2 Rear, 2 Front), 4 x USB 2.0 (2 Rear, 2 Front)
product_features.Networking: Intel Gigabit LAN, Intel 802.11ac WiFi + BT 4.2
product_features.Audio Codec: 7.1 CH HD Audio (Realtek ALC897 Audio Codec)
product_features.Cooling Features: Supports CPU fan, Chassis fan, and Chassis/Water Pump fan
product_features.BIOS Features: 128Mb AMI UEFI Legal BIOS with multilingual GUI support
product_features.Expansion Headers: 1 x Chassis Intrusion, 1 x Addressable LED, 1 x CPU Fan, 1 x Chassis Fan, 1 x Chassis/Water Pump Fan, 1 x Front Audio, 1 x USB 2.0, 1 x USB 3.2 Gen1
